sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Sparse paired pavement-limit observations selected after native cross-section image review across all 325 proposed pairs. RGB proposal positions served as authoring candidates, not accepted evidence without visual inspection. Rounded image observations and independently adjusted outer corners at source stations 672–678, 948–960, 1146–1161 and 1188–1200 avoid dark asphalt patches mistaken for road edges; station 1632 follows the visible inner pavement edge rather than the false 2 m search limit. The opening near station 282 and other shared-pavement branches use virtual route-selection joins, not surveyed racing limits. Corresponding edges interpolate linearly between sparse observations, with no nominal-width substitution. Source coordinates and direction are retained. NAIP pixel spacing is approximately 0.75 m, not positional survey accuracy. Curbs remain illustrative, banking unknown and raster heights estimated.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
